ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface area with approximately 15% coverage of high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters and streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white speckling and irregular geometric markings distributed across the entire surface; notable density of white pixels concentrated along the interior trailing edges and significant white clusters at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an acute angle of approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by numerous small-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex upward sweep on both the left and right lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white clusters at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; multiple smaller circular white scars scattered across the central and outer lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned linear white pixel disruptions, including multiple parallel rake marks and singular long streaks across both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization and associated scarring at both fluke tips; widespread rake marks and circular scarring indicative of previous physical interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density white stippling pattern most visible on the lower interior portions of the fluke near the median notch.
